title: Cheyenne, a seductive woman with large breasts, proud to be Swiss!
details: She's the best ambassador for her country, Switzerland! Cheyenne loves sharing the secrets of her homeland and is about to do so once again with Klem. But she quickly realizes that he's far more engrossed in her cleavage, which is barely containing her incredible breasts! To finally convince him to take a trip to the land of fondue, she decides to prove that she's at least as naughty as her French neighbors, much to her host's delight, of course...
